paraphrase: A SQLite3 header is100bytes with fixed magic and fixed payload fraction bytes64/32/32. BE page-size field accepts powers2 from512 through32768, or1 for65536. Header pagecount is authoritative only when nonzero and change-counter agrees with version-valid-for; legacy/stale counts cannot alone reject an otherwise plausible file. Header match alone does not establish a complete database extent or readable schema.
